_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante : Domestic Rev (~92% CA), Computing & Mobile (categorie #1), Consumer Electronics, Services (recurrent), Appliances. FY = annee fiscale Best Buy (FY25 = annee se terminant feb 1 2025).

kpis.signal: Recul continu post-pic FY22 (~92% CA Best Buy), normalisation post-COVID + macro consumer electronics
kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Domestic (US + Best Buy Health). 92% du CA. Recul continu depuis pic FY22 ($47.8Mds), retour vers niveau pre-COVID.
kpis.description_en: Domestic segment revenue (US + Best Buy Health). 92% of total. Continuous decline since FY22 peak ($47.8B), reverting to pre-COVID level.

kpis.signal: Categorie #1 (~45% CA Domestic), legere reprise FY25 (PC AI + smartphones)
kpis.description_fr: Revenus categorie Computing & Mobile Phones (laptops, PCs, mobiles, tablettes, wearables). Categorie #1 Domestic (~45% CA segment).
kpis.description_en: Computing & Mobile Phones revenue (laptops, PCs, mobile phones, tablets, wearables). #1 Domestic category (~45% of segment sales).

kpis.signal: Repli continu depuis pic FY22, pression TV/home theater apres saturation marche
kpis.description_fr: Revenus categorie Consumer Electronics (imagerie, audio, TV, home theater, smart home). Repli structurel post-pic FY22.
kpis.description_en: Consumer Electronics revenue (imaging, audio, TV, home theater, smart home). Structural decline post-FY22 peak.

kpis.signal: Services (Geek Squad + memberships) en croissance continue, pilier recurrent
kpis.description_fr: Revenus categorie Services Domestic (Geek Squad, My Best Buy Memberships, plans de protection). Pilier recurrent en croissance.
kpis.description_en: Domestic Services revenue (Geek Squad, My Best Buy Memberships, protection plans). Recurring revenue pillar in growth.

kpis.signal: Recul tres marque (-16% YoY) lie au cycle housing US (baisse turnover immobilier + report achats gros electromenagers)
kpis.description_fr: Revenus categorie Appliances Domestic (gros et petit electromenager). Repli marque -16% YoY FY25 (cycle housing US).
kpis.description_en: Domestic Appliances revenue (major and small appliances). Sharp -16% YoY FY25 decline (US housing cycle).

_notes: Source : 10-K Best Buy FY21-FY25 SEC EDGAR. FY se termine fin janvier / debut fevrier. FY25 = annee se terminant 1 fev 2025 (~calendrier 2024).
